criteria.name: ML Model Development
criteria.guidance: Build suitable regression models using calendar, lag and rolling features that only use past information.

criteria.name: Hyperparameter Tuning & Validation
criteria.guidance: Use chronological or rolling validation; do not shuffle time series or tune against the final holdout.

criteria.name: Model Comparison & Performance Evaluation
criteria.guidance: Compare models and simple baselines on the same horizon using MAE/RMSE/sMAPE and relevant group breakdowns.

criteria.name: Feature Importance & Residual Analysis
criteria.guidance: Inspect feature importance and residual patterns by time/store/item without making causal claims.

criteria.name: Forecast Segmentation & Business Interpretation
criteria.guidance: Evaluate forecasts across store/item groups and explain operational implications with measured evidence.
